footer: {brand} · This is an automated message regarding your account. Exclusively for adults aged 18 and over.

verifyEmail.subject: Please confirm your email — {brand}
verifyEmail.heading: Welcome to {brand}.
verifyEmail.body:
Thank you for creating your account.
Please confirm your email address to activate it. The link is valid for 48 hours.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your password — {brand}
resetPassword.heading: Choose a new password.
resetPassword.body:
We received a request to reset the password of your account.
The link is valid for one hour. If you did not request this, you can ignore this email.

changeEmail.subject: Confirm your new email address — {brand}
changeEmail.heading: Confirm your new email address.
changeEmail.body: Please confirm that you would like to use this address for your {brand} account.

emailChanged.subject: Your email address was changed — {brand}
emailChanged.heading: Your email address was changed.
emailChanged.body:
The email address of your account was changed to {newEmail}.
If you did not make this change, please contact us immediately.

newMessage.subject: {creator} has replied — {brand}
newMessage.heading: You have a new message.
newMessage.body:
{creator} has replied to your conversation.
For your privacy, message contents are only visible in your account.

adminNewMessage.subject: New client message — {brand}
adminNewMessage.heading: A client has written to you.

offerReceived.subject: A personal offer for you — {brand}
offerReceived.heading: Your personal offer is ready.
offerReceived.body:
{creator} has prepared a personal offer: {title}.
Review it in your private conversation.

orderConfirmation.subject: Order {number} confirmed — {brand}
orderConfirmation.heading: Thank you for your order.
orderConfirmation.body:
Your order {number} has been paid successfully.
Total: {total}.
Your photographs are available in your account under My Purchases.

refundUpdate.subject: Update on order {number} — {brand}
refundUpdate.heading: An update on your order.
refundUpdate.body:
Order {number} has been updated: {status}.
Access to the affected items has been adjusted accordingly.

requestUpdate.subject: Your request {number} — {brand}
requestUpdate.heading: Your personal request has an update.

deliveryReady.subject: Your personal collection is ready — {brand}
deliveryReady.heading: Your personal collection is ready.
deliveryReady.body:
{creator} has delivered your personal collection.
You can view and download it securely in your account.

subscribeConfirm.subject: Please confirm your subscription — {brand}
subscribeConfirm.heading: One more step.
subscribeConfirm.body:
Please confirm that you would like to receive announcements about new collections from {brand}.
You can unsubscribe at any time.

adminNewOrder.subject: New order {number} — {brand}
adminNewOrder.heading: A new order has been paid.

adminNewRequest.subject: New personal request {number} — {brand}
adminNewRequest.heading: A new personal request has arrived.

accountDeleted.subject: Your account has been deleted — {brand}
accountDeleted.heading: Your account has been deleted.
accountDeleted.body:
As requested, your account and personal data have been deleted.
Invoices that we are legally required to keep are retained in anonymised form.
